name: Craft Kraft
tagline: AutoMontage's craft theme: black stage, kraft cards, terracotta accent, Oswald captions, jump cuts and one peak per reel.

motion.direction: AutoMontage `craft`. Kraft cards (`mar`, radius 26, warm shadow) on black, terracotta `ter` accent, Oswald display; captions < 4 words, < 1.6 s, milk text on a dark plate with the spoken word in `ter`. Camera: jump cuts between 1.0 / 1.18 / 1.12 (≥ 15 % scale change) — never a hold over 2.2 s without an event; cards sit beside the face (≤ 28 % width, alternating sides), never over it. Text holds ≥ 1.2 s (+0.3 s per word over four); a visual event every 1.5–2.2 s; exactly ONE peak per reel (punch + hit + big `posterText`), not in the first 2 s. No bounce, no elastic, nothing covering the speaker early.
